Sonny Baker | Player of the Match 1/2: [On being Player of the Match and his performances across the series] Yeah, really happy. I mean, obviously, when things go like that, you're always pleased. [On the difference in conditions compared with the previous two games] In the previous two games, it swung a lot up top, whereas today there wasn't really very much movement at all. So it was just trying to adapt to the conditions and go from there. [On the amount of swing in the first two games and whether it was related to the time of year] Well, I mean, generally I take about 25 minutes picking the ball, but it didn't make any difference today. But yeah, I think part of that, I mean, it's something I've worked really, really hard on over the rehabs I've had, building into now, and being able to swing the ball both ways just buys you that extra bit of margin, for sure.

Asalanka 2/2: [On preparing for the three-match ODI series and whether Sri Lanka can improve significantly enough to be competitive] I think yes. As players, we have to look back and forget everything and everything else, and be prepared for ODI series because it's also important for us to coming up next year we have a very important ODI World Cup as well. So it's very important for us. And, I mean, the talent is there, and recently we have been playing good cricket in ODIs especially. So we just want to think back ourselves and what we have done well recently when we are doing well. So we have to just keep doing that things.

Harry Brook | Player of the Series | PCA Player of the Summer | England captain 1/2: [On a great personal series, the team's success, and returning to number one in the rankings] Yeah, an amazing achievement again and one that everybody should be really proud of. [On England winning the series comfortably and what he takes from the individual performances despite the one-sided result] I think everybody stepped up in this series, especially lads who haven't played as much. Sonny [Baker], for example, bowling three overs in the powerplay in two games is an amazing achievement to not go for the amount of runs that a lot of people do in the powerplay as well, taking wickets. Daws [Dawson] again, awesome performer, Jos [Buttler] again. I could go through that whole team, but yeah, we're adapting to conditions really well. Every game's been slightly different and we're playing the conditions extremely well.

Brook 2/2: [On the team appearing close to its peak and the challenge of maintaining that level as attention shifts towards ODIs, the World Cup and the Ashes] Again, it all comes down to adapting to conditions really. We want to be a side where when the conditions aren't in our favour, we're still able to manufacture a win. And that might not be the prettiest, but I think we're doing that extremely well and we're definitely trending in the right direction. [On managing his workload with both England coaches and the demands of Test and white-ball cricket] I've said plenty of times I want to play as much cricket as I can for England. That's my main priority, hence why I don't play any franchise cricket, bar the Hundred. So yeah, that's my main focus: trying to stay as fit and as ready as I possibly can for England.
